title: Agent sign-in and billing
description: The body of the <agent>.auth record in an account snapshot: one shape for every agent, saying how the agent is signed in and who pays for its model calls. Built from named fields only; it never carries a token, key, or a hash of one.

schema.description: Record version. Unknown values are a downstream hard error, not a partial read.

agent.description: The catalog family without its suffix, as in the snapshot's file name.

billing.description: Who pays for model calls. subscription: a seat or plan with the agent's vendor. api: metered per call on a key. cloud: a cloud provider's account, such as Bedrock or Vertex. local: a model served on the machine. unknown: nothing on disk says, as when a key comes only from the shell environment.

auth_method.description: How the agent proves itself to its provider.

provider.description: Who serves the model calls: the vendor, a cloud, or the provider id the agent's config names.

plan.description: The vendor's own plan name, as stored, such as pro, max, team or enterprise.

subscription_until.description: End of the current paid period, when the vendor stores one.

evidence.description: The file and field each decision came from, as file:field, in the order they were weighed.
